reviewMethod: Fresh sequential FFmpeg showinfo PTS; sequential OpenCV frame-index crosswalk. All consecutive frames from latest PTS <= window start through first PTS >= window end, inclusive. Boundary frames may provide context outside the exact window. 48 chronological frames per sheet, row-major, aspect-preserved 320x180 cells, caption source PTS ms and frame index. No subsampling. All 147 sheets were actually inspected through view_image at original sheet resolution, in chronological order. Each cell is aspect-preserved within 320x180 pixels; portrait imagery is consequently smaller. Every covering decoded frame was included, without temporal subsampling. This is static visual inspection, not real-time playback.
decisionPolicy: Supported-normal means the visible window supports ordinary nonfight activity under provisional assistant review. Ordinary embrace/contact is permitted. Unresolved people/interactions, occlusion or insufficient detail yield unknown for the entire candidate window. Unknown has no target label. Boundary context does not extend annotation bounds.
blinding: No classifier scores, predictions, models, GPU jobs or model-dependent selection used in this review.
limitations: Assistant static-image review is not human ground truth, motion playback or proof of absence of hidden contact. Complete frame coverage does not resolve occlusion.
Aspect-preserved contact-sheet cells reduce spatial detail. Small/hidden group interactions were conservatively retained as unknown; no native-resolution visibility claim.
Only the frozen 49 candidate windows are adjudicated. Original intervals, margins and tails outside these windows are not newly approved as normal.
All development windows remain unknown. Supported windows all retain reserved-audit roles; roles must not be reassigned to obtain development negatives.
Two supported windows (8 seconds) are easier dog/handler controls, including one animal-only window (4 seconds). They do not establish hard human-motion robustness.
Source-author grouping is inherited unchanged. Actor/session independence and publisher-pretrain overlap remain unknown.
No accuracy, operational camera-hour, 50-100-person crowd, near-IR, thermal or low-light colour CCTV capability claim. No identity, intent, injury, crime or guilt inference.
Source rights/attribution and transformation lineage remain those in the pinned original bundle. No new rights clearance or participant releases are implied.
